fact: 威廉·塔夫脱（William Taft）于1909年3月4日宣誓就任美国总统，他在就职演说中表示，任何接过这一誓言的人都会感到责任的沉重。

sources.title: March 4, 1909: Inaugural Address — Miller Center, University of Virginia
sources.quote: My Fellow-Citizens: Anyone who has taken the oath I have just taken must feel a heavy weight of responsibility. If not, he has no conception of the powers and duties of the office upon which he is about to enter, or he is lacking in a proper sense of the obligation which the oath imposes.

fact: 塔夫脱在1909年就职演说中承诺，把维护和执行前任发起的反托拉斯改革作为其任期的重要内容，这些改革针对铁路和州际工商领域大资本组合的违法与滥用权力行为。

sources.title: March 4, 1909: Inaugural Address — Miller Center
sources.quote: I should be untrue to myself, to my promises, and to the declarations of the party platform upon which I was elected to office, if I did not make the maintenance and enforcement of those reforms a most important feature of my administration. They were directed to the suppression of the lawlessness and abuses of power of the great combinations of capital invested in railroads and in industrial enterprises carrying on interstate commerce.

fact: 美国宪法第16修正案（联邦所得税修正案）于1909年7月2日经国会通过，1913年2月3日获得批准，确立了国会对所得征税的权利。

sources.title: 16th Amendment to the U.S. Constitution: Federal Income Tax (1913) — U.S. National Archives
sources.quote: Passed by Congress on July 2, 1909, and ratified February 3, 1913, the 16th amendment established Congress's right to impose a Federal income tax.

fact: 1909年10月8日，威尔伯·赖特在马里兰州科利奇帕克（College Park）开始为拉姆与汉弗莱斯两名中尉上飞行课；10月26日汉弗莱斯中尉完成首次单飞。

sources.title: U.S. Centennial of Flight — Timeline: 1909
sources.quote: 8-Oct-09 Wilbur Wright begins giving flying lessons to Lieutenants Lahm and Humphreys at College Park, Maryland.

sources.title: U.S. Centennial of Flight — Timeline: 1909
sources.quote: 26-Oct-09 Lt. Humphreys solos for the first time.

fact: 1909年8月2日，莱特军用飞机（Wright Military Flyer）正式被美国陆军通信兵接收，编号Signal Corps Airplane No. 1，这是世界上第一架军用飞机。

sources.title: U.S. Centennial of Flight — Timeline: 1909
sources.quote: 2-Aug-09 The Wright Military Flyer is formally accepted by the U.S. Signal Corps. It receives the designation Signal Corps Airplane No. 1. It is the world's first military airplane.

fact: 莱特公司（The Wright Company）于1909年11月成立，把赖特兄弟的飞机制造业务企业化。

sources.title: U.S. Centennial of Flight — Timeline: 1909
sources.quote: Nov-09 The Wright Company is founded.

fact: 1907年金融恐慌使美国工业产出在1908年下降17%、实际GNP下降12%（仅次于大萧条），但实体经济在此后一年多内迅速恢复，1909年正处于这一复苏期。

sources.title: The Panic of 1907 — Federal Reserve History
sources.quote: It is also important to note that the Panic of 1907 had severe real effects. Industrial output fell 17 percent in 1908, and real GNP fell by 12 percent. Only the Great Depression was more severe. But unlike the Great Depression or the recent Great Recession, the real sector recovered rapidly, in little over a year after 1907.

fact: 1909年7月9日，格伦·柯蒂斯（Glenn Curtiss）驾驶Golden Flyer第二次赢得科学美国人奖杯（Scientific American trophy）。

sources.title: U.S. Centennial of Flight — Timeline: 1909
sources.quote: 9-Jul Glenn Curtiss pilots his Golden Flyer to win the Scientific American trophy for the second time

fact: 1909年施行的1907年《移民法》（34 Stat. 898）第12条要求：任何船舶抵港时，船长须向港口移民官提交在启航地制作的乘客清单，逐人载明姓名、年龄、性别、婚否、职业、读写能力、国籍、种族、最后住所、来本国最近亲属的姓名地址、登岸港口与最终目的地、是否持直达票、旅费由本人或何人（何机构）支付、是否携带50美元及不足时的具体数额、投奔何人、曾否到过美国及时间地点、有无监禁或济贫院或疯人院经历、是否多配偶者或无政府主义者、是否因劳动招揽而来、健康状况与残疾情况等二十余项身份与状况信息，清单经船长宣誓核验。

sources.title: Chap. 1134 — An Act To regulate the immigration of aliens into the United States, February 20, 1907, 34 Stat. 898（美国政府出版局govinfo官方档案）
sources.quote: it shall be the duty of the master or commanding officer of the steamer, sailing or other vessel having said alien on board to deliver to the immigration officers at the port of arrival lists or manifests made at the time and place of embarkation ... state as to each alien the full name, age, and sex; whether married or single; the calling or occupation; whether able to read or write; the nationality; the race; the last residence; the name and address of the nearest relative in the country from which the alien came ... whether in possession of fifty dollars, and if less, how much ... whether ever before in the United States, and if so, when and where; whether ever in prison or almshouse or an institution or hospital for the care and treatment of the insane

fact: 1907年《移民法》同时规定：对每名进入美国的外国人征收4美元人头税，由到港口岸的海关征收官向船方收取；抵港外国人须按每份不超过30人的名单分组列册，并向每名外国人或家长长发放写有其姓名、组号与组内序号的登岸识别票以便身份识别；离境外国人的清单须在开航前提交海关并作为船舶结关的条件。此外，若总统认定某国签发的护照被用于使其公民经第三国进入美国本土而损害当地劳工条件，总统可禁止持该国护照者入境。

sources.title: Chap. 1134 — An Act To regulate the immigration of aliens into the United States, February 20, 1907, 34 Stat. 898（美国政府出版局govinfo官方档案，第1、12、13条）
sources.quote: That there shall be levied, collected, and paid a tax of four dollars for every alien entering the United States. ... To each alien or head of a family shall be given a ticket on which shall be written his name, a number or letter designating the list in which his name, and so forth, is contained, and his number on said list, for convenience of identification on arrival. ... no master of any such vessel shall be granted clearance papers for his vessel until he has deposited such list or lists with the collector of customs at the port of departure ... whenever the President shall be satisfied that passports issued by any foreign government ... are being used for the purpose of enabling the holders to come to the continental territory of the United States to the detriment of labor conditions therein, the President may refuse to permit such citizens of the country issuing such passports to enter

fact: 据1910年人口普查报告，1909年美国制造业在册工人6,631,931人，全年工资总额34.3473亿美元，人均年工资517.91美元，折合每周不足10美元——这是1909年美国工业就业者的平均收入水平。

sources.title: Abraham Epstein, Facing old age: a study of old age dependency in the United States and old age pensions（Gutenberg eBook #77562，转引1910年美国人口普查报告）
sources.quote: The 1910 Census Reports give the average number of wage-earners engaged in manufacturing in 1909 as 6,631,931. The total amount spent in wages in those industries during that year was $3,434,734,000. When this total is divided by the average number of wage-earners the quotient is $517.91, which was the average wage during that year and which is below $10 per week.

fact: 查平（R. C. Chapin）1909年对纽约市家庭收支的预算研究估算：曼哈顿区一个五口之家（父母加三名14岁以下子女）维持'相当不错的'生活水平，全年需约825美元——这是当时对美国大城市生活成本的权威测算之一。

sources.title: Abraham Epstein, Facing old age: a study of old age dependency in the United States and old age pensions（Gutenberg eBook #77562，转引Chapin 1909年预算研究与纽约慈善事业会议结论）
sources.quote: From budget studies made by Dr. R. C. Chapin in 1909, the New York State Conference of Charities and Corrections concluded that: “It is fairly conservative to estimate that $825 is sufficient for the average family of five individuals, comprising the father, mother and three children under 14 years of age, to maintain a fairly proper standard of living in the borough of Manhattan.”

fact: 美国农业部公布的1909年农场雇工工资：户外农工含食宿日均1.43美元；不含食宿的户外农工月均工资25.46美元，折合全年305.52美元——乡村受雇劳动者的现金收入水平。

sources.title: Abraham Epstein, Facing old age: a study of old age dependency in the United States and old age pensions（Gutenberg eBook #77562，转引U.S. Department of Agriculture 1909年农场工资）
sources.quote: The U. S. Department of Agriculture also gave the farm wages during the year 1909. ... outdoor farm labour with board averaged $1.43 a day, while the average monthly wage for outdoor farm labour quoted for the year without board was $25.46 or $305.52 per year.
